pages.text: Everything in CyberFarm runs on $(l)FE$() (Forge Energy): the Drone Assembler builds with it and the Drone Dock charges your drones with it. The machines in this section make that power. FE is a standard, so generators from other mods work just

$(li)$(l)1$(): $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l), any furnace fuel, 60 FE/t, a furnace, iron, copper, redstone$(br)$(li)$(l)2$(): $(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l), Biogas, 20 mB/t, 100 FE/t, a furnace, a Basic Circuit, 2 $(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frames$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l)2$(): Gas Turbine, Methane, 20 mB/t, 240 FE/t, same
pages.title: Which generator?

pages.text: $(li)$(l)2.5$(): $(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l), Biogas, 45 mB/t, 405 FE/t, 2 blast furnaces, an Advanced Circuit, 5 Cyber Frames$(br)$(li)$(l)2.5$(): Steam Engine, Methane, 45 mB/t, 675 FE/t, same$(br)$(li)$(l)3$(): $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) + $(l:nuclear/steam_turbine)Steam Turbine$(/l), Uranium Fuel Rods, 2,000 to 40,000 FE/t per turbine, Elite Circuits, uranium, a big multiblock
The Steam Engine's 5 Cyber Frames are one in its recipe and 4 in the finished row.

Gas generators need a steady flow of gas. Two machines make it:$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l): 10 mB/t of Biogas, Biomass from a $(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass Press$(/l), which presses farm waste
pages.title: Where the gas comes from

pages.text: $(li)$(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l): 50 mB/t of Methane from a zombie, 25 from other monsters, 8 from animals, a 3x3x4 chamber, a mob, and Acid from an $(l:generators/acid_synthesizer)Acid Synthesizer$(/l)$(br)Some of these machines draw power themselves, so the first FE has to come from somewhere else:$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass Press$(/l): 8 FE/t

$(li)When you are tired of shovelling fuel, move on to $(l:generators/gas_power)Gas Power$(/l). A Bio-Digester turns farm waste into Biogas. A Methane Extractor draws Methane from a mob dissolving in Acid. A Gas Turbine burns both.$(br)$(li)For more power from the same gas, build a $(l)Steam Engine$().

$(li)The most power comes from the $(l:nuclear/nuclear)Nuclear$(/l) section. A Fission Reactor burns uranium $(l:nuclear/fuel_rod)Fuel Rods$(/l) into steam for Steam Turbines. The $(l:nuclear/coolant_mixer)Coolant Mixer$(/l) helps cool it. Its waste must go to a $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l), or the area turns $(l:nuclear/radiation)radioactive$(/l).

A zombie chamber is the big step in gas power. Its methane makes about $(l)600 FE/t$() in Gas Turbines: as much as twelve Bio-Digesters. One Gas Turbine burns 20 mB/t, so it takes two and a half turbines. The same chamber keeps a Steam Engine running at 675 FE/t. That is still less than the smallest reactor at full power.

$(li)$(l)Coal or charcoal$(): $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l), 60 FE/t, 40 seconds, 48,000 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)Block of coal$(): Combustion Generator, 400 seconds, 480,000 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)A log or planks$(): Combustion Generator, 7.5 seconds, 9,000 FE
pages.title: How long fuels last

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Blaze rod$(): Combustion Generator, 60 seconds, 72,000 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)Lava bucket$(): Combustion Generator, 500 seconds, 600,000 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)Biomass$(): $(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l), 2.5 seconds each, becomes 500 mB of Biogas, 2,500 FE in a Gas Turbine, 4,500 in a Steam Engine

$(li)$(l)1,000 mB of Biogas$(): $(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l), 100 FE/t, 2.5 seconds, 5,000 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)1,000 mB of Methane$(): Gas Turbine, 240 FE/t, 2.5 seconds, 12,000 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)1,000 mB of Biogas$(): $(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l), 405 FE/t, 1.1 seconds, 9,000 FE
$(li)$(l)1,000 mB of Methane$(): Steam Engine, 675 FE/t, 1.1 seconds, 15,000 FE$(br)The Combustion Generator burns any furnace fuel for half as long as a furnace would.
Gases burn fast, so size a gas plant by its $(l)flow$(): a Gas Turbine needs 20 mB/t (two Bio-Digesters), a Steam Engine 45 mB/t.
The Combustion Generator, the Gas Turbine and the Steam Engine push their FE into adjacent machines by themselves. To reach machines further away, use $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l).
